name: abletime
description: Record time and run the AbleTime board from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Record time and run the board
interface.longDescription: AbleTime for Codex records time and runs the project board. One connection covers time, tasks, and the board. A second connection covers reports and returns a share link. Skills cover recording, watches, intake, sorting, a bugfix pull request, the board, reports, and a walkthrough. Recording rules load when a session starts, after the hooks are trusted. A watch stays on the Codex session that started it and sends hits through AbleTime rather than chat.
defaultPrompt: Record the time on the work I am doing.
Give me a share link for this week's hours.
